sources.note: On Problem 6: 正正皆當作負. Read by the literature check in an online transcription, not by this project.

sources.title: K. Chemla and Guo Shuchun, “Les neuf chapitres: le classique mathématique de la Chine ancienne et ses commentaires”, Dunod, 2004
sources.note: Problem 6’s 負, crediting Li Huang, p. 632, n. 51; the emendation of Liu Hui’s 77 passage, pp. 652–655, nn. 93–104. Read in part by the literature check, not by this project.

sources.title: R. Hart, “The Chinese Roots of Linear Algebra”, Johns Hopkins University Press, 2011
sources.note: Problem 14’s 33/111 and the determinant, pp. 173–174. Read in part by the literature check, not by this project.

sources.title: 郭书春 (Guo Shuchun), 九章筭术译注（修订本）, 上海古籍出版社, 2020
sources.note: Liu Hui’s 77 passage, emended and tallied to 77, ch. 8, nn. 22–40; the 124, nn. 41–82; the rates 7:4:3:5:6, nn. 63–69. Read in part by the literature check and the source extraction, not by this project.

sources.title: R. Hart, “Tracing Practices Purloined by the ‘Three Pillars’”, The Korean Journal for the History of Science 34(2), 2012, pp. 287–357
sources.note: A reconstruction of Liu Hui’s old method in rods, never more than 77 on the board, with the count after each of fifteen steps, pp. 322–329. Read by the source extraction, not by this project.

sources.title: Source extraction for Guo’s and Hart’s reconstructions, by OpenAI Codex with web search, 24 November 2026
sources.note: Guo’s emended passage and the apparatus of Chemla and Guo, his tally by block, and Hart’s steps and counts, each marked as read from the source, reconstructed, or not readable. The two pages assert only what it marks as read.

sources.title: Wei Xuegang and Guo Shirong, 自然科学史研究 35(1), 2016, pp. 10–17; Zhu Yiwen, “A new perspective on Liu Hui’s mathematical achievements”, Cultures of Science 8(S2), 2025, pp. 161–171
sources.note: 算 in the 77 and 124 passages read as counting rods. The first read only in its abstract by the literature check.

sources.title: Coding-agent sessions, 23 and 24 November 2026
sources.note: The transcription, the program and its tests were made in these sessions by a coding agent and its sub-agents, and changed after the review. Every result in this note can be rerun on the interactive study or with cargo test in the repository.
